name.ja: ブレーマーフェルデ要塞

text.cs: Bremervörde Castle, also called Vörde Castle, in the German town of Bremervörde in northern Lower Saxony was the largest fortification in the region. It was slighted in 1682 after various military conflicts and largely demolished.
text.da: Bremervörde Castle, also called Vörde Castle, in the German town of Bremervörde in northern Lower Saxony was the largest fortification in the region. It was slighted in 1682 after various military conflicts and largely demolished.
text.de: Das befestigte Schloss Bremervörde in Bremervörde im nördlichen Niedersachsen war die größte Schlossanlage der Region. Sie wurde nach diversen kriegerischen Auseinandersetzungen 1682 geschleift und größtenteils abgetragen.
